question: Which element created by bombarding California-249 with a carbon-12 nucleus is named in honour of New Zealand chemist Ernest Rutherford, who was the first to explain the structure of atoms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Element 104**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Element 104 created by bombarding California-249 with a carbon-12 nucleus is named in honour of New Zealand chemist Ernest Rutherford, who was the first to explain the structure of atoms.**
 
• **Ernest Rutherford, 1st Baron Rutherford of Nelson, OM, FRS, HonFRSE,** was a New Zealander physicist who became renowned as the father of nuclear physics (30 August 1871–19 October 1937).
 
• He is regarded by **Encyclopaedia Britannica** as the finest experimentalist.
 
• In 1917, he conducted the **first artificially generated nuclear reaction using nitrogen nuclei **that had been subjected to an alpha particle bombardment. As a result, he found the **emission of a subatomic particle **that he first identified as the proton in 1920 after initially referring to it as the **"hydrogen atom" in 1919.**
 
• He was interred next to **Sir Isaac Newton at Westminster Abbey** upon his passing in 1937.** In 1997, the atom rutherfordium (element 104) was named in his honour.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In 1914, Rutherford was knighted. He worked on a **top-secret effort to address the issues with submarine detection by sonar during World War I.**
 
• He went back to the **Cavendish in 1919, taking J. J. Thomson's place** as director and professor there.
 
• **James Chadwick** **received Nobel Prize** during his tenure for discovering the neutron.
 
• In the 1925 New Year's Honours, he was named to the Order of Merit and elevated to the peerage of Baron Rutherford of Nelson.
